title: Desk wake triggered by the VM: gate + desk-wake marker on ops-flags PR (replaces the hourly spawner routine)
note: [2026-10-26 lane DESK-WAKE-VM] Packet landing IS the trigger (operator ~16:50Z): desk-scan-packet.yml's last steps run scripts/ops/desk_wake_marker.py post, ONE desk-wake marker on ops-flags #17895 carrying packet_id/sha/commit, deduped on packet id; failed build -> no wake, one could_not_build incident marker. Fallback chosen over the VM build (builder needs candle route + diag-token system book + two-file commit to the protected branch; too much runtime risk for this PR). VM src/runtime/desk_wake_watch.py (kicked from the tick loop) posts nothing; it writes desk_wake_post_receipt (posted/already_recorded/awaiting_wake/wake_missing/could_not_build/could_not_look) and attention_watch probe desk_wake_post flags a silent watch or wake_missing. Every hour wakes (crypto 24/7), no activity gate. Tier 2 by path: landing hold, manager merges. Manager retires trig_01NMCJ5LHARkp6vWgTmQ8BC9 after the first marker-spawned wake writes its row.
